decisions.question: Geographical confluence versus structural convergence
decisions.resolution: Clarify have converged as have come together in a new version, preserving the old English and the explicit diversity of the languages.

decisions.question: Resources created for the reader
decisions.resolution: Clarify the singular dative beneficiary as for the reader in a new version; preserve the old English and its links.

decisions.question: Deferred grammars and shorter treatment
decisions.resolution: Preserve possibility, deferment, follow-on order and brevity enabled by references to already included particulars.

decisions.question: Particular detail and personal publication contingency
decisions.resolution: Repeat particulars and preserve the conditional inability of the author to supply separate treatments, without promising their completion.

decisions.question: Time and multiple contributors
decisions.resolution: Retain both time and several people with the same purpose and viewpoints; do not turn the group into a promised funded team.

decisions.question: Accessibility, all known languages and continuing correction
decisions.resolution: Keep the conditional accessibility aim, all known languages, same principles, material for new inquiry and updating in keeping with advancing knowledge.

decisions.question: Two modes and the classificatory analogy
decisions.resolution: Retain human language in general, idioms as particular languages, species/genus analogy and the different purpose/treatment of the geographical-historical mode.

decisions.question: Natural-history comparison
decisions.resolution: Retain plants and kinds of stone without importing modern biological/geological categories.

decisions.question: Systematic placement versus regional aggregate
decisions.resolution: Distinguish physical place from position in the classificatory system. Treat rock deposits collectively and retain uncertainty about the period geological term.

decisions.question: Different objects of presentation
decisions.resolution: In each case distinguish presenting the languages/natural objects from presenting the region in terms of them.

decisions.question: Two directions and relative prevalence
decisions.resolution: Keep both directions as required and preserve the comparative, historically bounded prevalence of the latter.

decisions.question: Interdependent perspectives and repeated Gattung
decisions.resolution: Keep both reasons against complete separation, all influencing circumstances, prior knowledge and the printed new-genus wording with an explicit kind/rank alternative.

decisions.question: Distinct method/content and chiefly historical affiliation
decisions.resolution: Render werden with adjective as turn out to be, retain entire difference in method/content and chiefly rather than exclusively for descent/relatedness inquiries.

decisions.question: Knowledge priority and comparative importance
decisions.resolution: Read these as the languages in themselves, retaining the alternative; keep always and by far the more important without generalising to all scholarship.

decisions.question: Topic priority, geographical fallback and connection
decisions.resolution: Preserve topic-appropriate order, conditional geographical order, south-to-north then west-to-east, and every means constrained by the main purpose.
